text: All code, comments, logs, and variable names are written in English.
Never use the system Python; always use each tool's own .venv (a dot-prefixed folder: .venv). Each tool uses its own venv.
Dependencies: direct pip install is forbidden; add to requirements.txt and install from there (protocols/dependency-management.md).
Docker containers run as non-root with the standard 'usrapp' user.
Commits: a single commit that groups everything, format type(core) in lowercase, no emojis or co-author.
Only commit when the user explicitly asks for it; never commit on your own initiative.
A commit is always followed by its push (commit + push in the same step); never leave a commit local only.
A commit without the 'candidate' marker doesn't carry it, and adding it is never inferred; the marker is only included when the user explicitly asks for it.
Before setting direction, read local data, memories, and protocols; if that isn't enough, ask instead of improvising.
Never infer knowledge automatically; always verify against the real source, and ask if it can't be verified.
Never infer the name of a specific resource (dashboard uid, service/cluster, metric, file, profile, cloud resource, etc.). ALWAYS check the real name in the source before using or referencing it.

Never give an answer, value, or deliverable without first VALIDATING the result and the resource's real state against the source. Validate everything and be certain before responding; never claim something is 'done' or state a fact without having verified it in the moment.
